name: Who Is Ethan?
detailed_description:
"Who is Ethan?" is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror game where fear lurks in every shadow.

You wake up in an abandoned hospital, disoriented and alone—or so you think. Something is watching.
Work with your team to decipher cryptic clues, explore eerie corridors, and unveil the twisted history hidden within these walls.
But remember… Some questions should never be answered.

🔪 Can you survive the nightmare? 🔪

Key Features:

👥 1-4 Player Co-Op: Team up with friends or go in alone for the ultimate terror.
🕵️ Deep Mystery & Investigation: Solve disturbing puzzles and piece together the truth.
👻 Adaptive AI & Unpredictable Threats: No two playthroughs are the same—something always lurks in the dark.
🔊 Immersive 3D Sound Design: Every creak, whisper, and footstep could mean danger.
🕯️ Limited Resources & Perma-Death: Every decision could be your last—choose wisely.

Will you escape the hospital… or become part of its legend?

supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12288 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Latest drivers required for AMD and NVIDIA GPUs
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or equivalent
  • Storage: 12288 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Latest drivers required for AMD and NVIDIA GPUs

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave or higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 2.3 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Intel Iris Pro 5200 or better)
  • Storage: 12288 MB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS compatible sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 2.3 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU, 4 GB VRAM (AMD Radeon Pro or better)
  • Storage: 12288 MB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS compatible sound card
